evidence.detail: playability DECIMAL(6,5) in _season_archetype_playability — 5 decimal places, minimum non-zero value 0.00001
playability DECIMAL(6,5) in _playability — a card appearing 1 in 200,000 decks has playability 0.000005, which rounds to 0.00000 and is indistinguishable from never played

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/playability.py change all four `DECIMAL(6,5)` column definitions (lines 295, 426, 468, 490) to `DECIMAL(10,9)`. This gives 9 decimal places, so the minimum non-zero value becomes 0.000000001, far below the 1-in-200,000 threshold (0.000005). These are preaggregate tables rebuilt on each run so no manual migration is needed.
triage.notes: All four tables are created via CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _new{table} and then swapped in by the preaggregation framework, so the schema change takes effect automatically on the next preaggregate run. No historical data is lost or altered — only the precision of newly computed values changes.
